This should fix #12695 -- @bhcuong2008 could you please test and see if it solves your problem?

---

The main thread gets this because the thread state is in bss, but subsequent threads need this field to be initialised.

Also added a note to mpstate.h to help avoid missing this in the future.

issue_context.title: nlr_jump in MPY 1.21 causing ESP32 exception when catch exception executed in other micropython threads, not main thread REPL
comments: You mention threads in the discussion; how is your C code synchronized so that no other micropython code is running at the same time?

In ESP32 port of MicroPython, it synchronizes with thread mutex. So all threads under micropython is run one at a time, not same time. You can try with standard ESP32 port in MicroPython, with my test code in discussion. It will cause ESP32 exception as described.
```
#import uasyncio as asyncio # for 1.16
import asyncio
import _thread

async def _async_cb(params):
   print(params)   
   while True:
      print('Hello ' + str(params))
      await asyncio.sleep(params)

def testThread():
   asyncio.create_task(_async_cb(5))
   asyncio.create_task(_async_cb(10))
   loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
   loop.run_forever()
 
_thread.start_new_thread(testThread, ())
```
It solved. Thank u so much @jimmo.
